title: Bunny
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>

    <ellipse cx='38' cy='30' rx='7.5' ry='19' fill='#e8dfd6' transform='rotate(-12 38 30)'/>
    <!-- inner ear left -->
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='32' rx='3.6' ry='13' fill='#f4a7b9' transform='rotate(-12 38 32)'/>
    <!-- right ear outer -->
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='7.5' ry='19' fill='#e8dfd6' transform='rotate(12 62 30)'/>

    <ellipse cx='62' cy='32' rx='3.6' ry='13' fill='#f4a7b9' transform='rotate(12 62 32)'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='22' fill='#fbf3ea'/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <circle cx='38' cy='64' r='5' fill='#f9c9cf'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='64' r='5' fill='#f9c9cf'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='19' ry='14' fill='#f2e8dd'/>

    <ellipse cx='43' cy='90' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#fbf3ea'/>
    <ellipse cx='57' cy='90' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#fbf3ea'/>

    <ellipse cx='57' cy='55' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#5b4636'/>

    <circle cx='44' cy='53.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='53.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <path d='M47 62 L53 62 L50 66 Z' fill='#ef8a9c'/>
    <!-- mouth -->
    <path d='M50 66 Q50 70 46 70' stroke='#b08a7a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M50 66 Q50 70 54 70' stroke='#b08a7a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- whiskers -->
    <path d='M30 60 L20 57' stroke='#c9b6a8' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M30 64 L19 64' stroke='#c9b6a8' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M70 60 L80 57' stroke='#c9b6a8' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M70 64 L81 64' stroke='#c9b6a8' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
